newsitem.title: TAIWAN: China Steel July-Aug profit down 18 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Steel July-Aug profit down 18 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's China Steel said on Friday it had posted a pre-tax profit of T$2.868 billion between July and August, down 18 percent from T$3.503 billion in the same two-month period last year.
July-August sales were T$14.455 billion, down from T$14.537 billion from a year earlier, a company statement said.
In the month of August, China Steel reported a pre-tax profit of T$1.357 billion, down 29.5 percent from the same period last year.
The firm's August sales were T$7.234 billion, compared with T$7.450 billion in August 1995.
China Steel, previously state-owned, was privatised in April 1996. It reported a pre-tax profit of T$18.034 billion on sales of T$88.920 billion in fiscal 1995/96 (July-June)
